description: Implementation of a test tool class 'SimpleFramerVisitor' for processing and inspecting QUIC protocol packets in tests, including handling of various frame types and packet headers.

classes.name: SimpleFramerVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class implementing 'QuicFramerVisitorInterface' for testing, capturing and handling various QUIC packet events and frames.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes a QUIC encrypted packet using the internal framer and visitor.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal visitor to a new instance.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Returns the header of the last processed packet.

methods.name: version_negotiation_packet
methods.description: Returns the version negotiation packet if present.

methods.name: last_decrypted_level
methods.description: Returns the last decryption level of the processed packet.

methods.name: framer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal QuicFramer object.

methods.name: num_frames
methods.description: Returns the total number of frames captured.
